newsitem.title: USA: Times Mirror Q4 earnings summary.
newsitem.headline: Times Mirror Q4 earnings summary.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: Net profit figures are before payment of preferred dividends. Q4 net applicable to common shareholders was profit $67.8 million vs loss $175.5 million, and for year profit $162.8 million vs profit $1.1 bln.
Shr dil in Q4 1996 was not applicable as it was antidilutive.
Q4 1995 includes $67.3 million of nonrecurring costs.

Q4 1996 and 1995 include adjustments for asset sales and write-downs, as well as restructuring charges. After adjustments, Q4 net was $77.0 million, or $0.65/shr primary and $0.63/shr diluted, vs $57.1 million, or $0.42/shr primary.

Year 1996 and 1995 include adjustments for asset sales and write-downs, as well as restructuring charges. After adjustments, year net was $204.7 million, or $1.53/shr primary and $1.51/shr diluted, vs $139.6 million, or $0.84/shr primary.
